【原视频简介】
After Effects’ Roto Brush kept slowing down my anime edits, so I started building a rotoscoping tool designed around anime footage.

This is the first full look at the prototype. It uses Meta’s SAM 2 to select and track characters, gives me brush and lasso tools for fixing problem frames, and exports PNG mask sequences that I can use as track mattes in After Effects.

The tool is still a work in progress and is not available to download yet. I’m not a professional developer—this is my first coding project, and I’ve been building it through experimentation.

I’ll share another update as the prototype improves.
